title.en: What can be born next against what continues

statement.en: Of two courses of causal-set growth from the empty set, one includes the other's stems, what can be born next, exactly where its precedence is included in the other's, so widening adds no continuation. Read on what continues the inclusion reverses; no strict order holds both.
statement.zh: 于因果集之生长上，次可生者反转先后之包含：自空集起之二历程，一者含另一者之茎，恰当其先后含于另一者之先后；故扩大不增相续。读于相续则包含反转，无一严格之序兼含二者。

laws.en: Sequential growth. A stem is a set of elements closed downward (Stem); a move chooses one and adds the element size, preceded exactly by it (birth, process), from the empty set (empty, empty_ordered). A birth keeps a causal set a causal set (birth_ordered), keeps the precedence below every existing element (birth_holds) and makes the new element maximal (birth_maximal).
laws.zh: 序贯生长。茎为向下封闭之元集（Stem）；一步择一茎，添元 size，恰为其所先（birth、process），始于空集（empty、empty_ordered）。生使因果集仍为因果集（birth_ordered），保持每一已有元之下之先后（birth_holds），并使新元为极大（birth_maximal）。

laws.en: Internal temporality, with the parent kept as it was, is holding the past: every move keeps the elements and the order among them (HoldsPast, step_holdsPast), so the possible with the past held, UE11's possible relative to a held part, is the whole possible (possibleHeld_iff).
laws.zh: 内在时间性（亲构型保持原样）即持守过去：每一步皆保持诸元及其间之序（HoldsPast、step_holdsPast），故持守过去时之可能（UE11 相对于所持之部分之可能）即全部可能（possibleHeld_iff）。

laws.en: What each configuration admits next keeps widening on every course from a causal set. Every stem stays a stem across a birth (Stem.after); after each birth the stem of all elements is new (all, stem_all, not_stem_all_birth); so the stems keep widening in UE10's sense (ordered_of_run, keepsWidening), each possible from the course's start, inside a whole possible that never grows (stem_possible_from_start).
laws.zh: 自因果集起之每一历程上，每一构型次所纳者不断扩大。每茎经一生仍为茎（Stem.after）；每生之后全体元之茎为新（all、stem_all、not_stem_all_birth）；故茎依 UE10 之义不断扩大（ordered_of_run、keepsWidening），皆自历程之始可能，于永不增长之全部可能之内（stem_possible_from_start）。

laws.en: Stems reverse the inclusion of precedence. Of two configurations of one size, every stem of the first is a stem of the second exactly where the second's precedence is included in the first's (stems_included_iff); one direction takes the principal stem, an element and what precedes it (principal, stem_principal), the other is closure under the larger precedence.
laws.zh: 茎反转先后之包含。同大小之二构型，前者之每茎皆为后者之茎，恰当后者之先后含于前者之先后（stems_included_iff）；一向取主茎（一元及先之者，principal、stem_principal），另一向为于较大先后下之封闭。

laws.en: On courses. Along a course from the empty set the configuration at offset t has t elements and is a causal set (size_of_run, ordered_of_empty). Of two such courses, one includes the other's stems at every offset exactly where its precedence is included in the other's at every offset (rangeIncludes_iff), and strictly exactly where strictly, with no decision (rangeIncludes_strict_iff).
laws.zh: 于历程上。自空集起之历程，偏移 t 处之构型有 t 元且为因果集（size_of_run、ordered_of_empty）。二如是之历程，一者于每一偏移含另一者之茎，恰当其先后于每一偏移皆含于另一者之先后（rangeIncludes_iff）；严格者恰当严格，无需判定（rangeIncludes_strict_iff）。

laws.en: Of two courses from the empty set, widening what can be born next loses precedence (rangeWidens_strict), and losing a pair, the precedence included, widens it (rangeWidens_of). One exceeds the other's stems where it lacks a pair of the other (rangeExceeds_of_pair), only where an offset's inclusion fails (not_included_of_rangeExceeds); decided, the pair is found (pair_of_not_included, rangeExceeds_iff_pair).
laws.zh: 自空集起之二历程，扩大次可生者则失先后（rangeWidens_strict），先后被含而失一对则扩大之（rangeWidens_of）。一者缺另一者之对则超出其茎（rangeExceeds_of_pair），唯某偏移不含时方然（not_included_of_rangeExceeds）；可判定则得其对（pair_of_not_included 等）。

laws.en: Finding that pair for every two courses from the empty set is excluded middle (pair_converse_iff_em), already for widenings (em_of_widening_pair_converse): wherever P is not refuted the antichain exceeds the stems of the course bearing 2 above 0 exactly where P, and a pair of that course gives P (Undecided: onlyIfPast, onlyIf, with laws; stems_of_two). Which pair a widening loses is found by deciding.
laws.zh: 对自空集起之每二历程皆求得该对，即排中律（pair_converse_iff_em），仅求于扩大亦然（em_of_widening_pair_converse）：凡 P 未被否证，反链即超出恰于 P 时以 2 生于 0 上之历程之茎，而其一对给出 P（Undecided：onlyIf 等；stems_of_two）。扩大所失之对须判定而得。

laws.en: Of two courses from the empty set, widening adds no continuation of any class read on precedence (continuation_of_rangeIncludes). Within the one class continuation is precedence (continuation_one_iff), and on links too where precedence is decidable (continuation_links_one_iff), so there too including the other's stems adds none (continuation_links_one_of_rangeIncludes).
laws.zh: 自空集起之二历程，扩大不增任何读于先后之类之相续（continuation_of_rangeIncludes）。一类内相续即先后（continuation_one_iff），可判定时读于覆盖亦然（continuation_links_one_iff），故彼处含对方之茎亦不增相续（continuation_links_one_of_rangeIncludes）。

laws.en: Compared by both, two courses from the empty set have the same precedence: where one includes the other's stems and continues at least as much within the one class, their precedence is the same (prec_iff_of_both), so neither widens what can be born next while continuing as much (not_widens_and_continues).
laws.zh: 兼较二者，自空集起之二历程先后相同：一者含另一者之茎且一类内相续不少，则二者先后相同（prec_iff_of_both）；故无一者既扩大次可生者又相续不少（not_widens_and_continues）。

laws.en: Courses given by their pasts. After births with given pasts the configuration has i before j exactly where j is born by then with i in its past (grown, grown_size, grown_prec_iff); given that each past is a stem when chosen, the births are a course from the empty set (course, course_start).
laws.zh: 以过去给出之历程。依所给之过去而生之后，构型中 i 先于 j，恰当 j 已生且 i 在其过去之中（grown、grown_size、grown_prec_iff）；设每一过去于被择时皆为茎，则诸生为自空集起之历程（course、course_start）。

laws.en: Links on the growth: that every pair on every configuration of every course from the empty set is reached by links is excluded middle, since at offset 3 the growth reaches the three elements whose relations through the middle are a proposition (Undecided: thirdPast, thirdPast_stems, thirdCourse, thirdCourse_prec_iff; reach_links_courses_iff_em).
laws.zh: 生长上之覆盖：自空集起之每一历程之每一构型之每一对皆由覆盖及之，即排中律，因生长于偏移 3 达至经中间者之关系为一命题之三元（Undecided：thirdCourse 等；reach_links_courses_iff_em）。

laws.en: Births with empty pasts (antichain, antichain_prec): the course includes the stems of every course from the empty set (antichain_rangeIncludes) and widens those of every such course with a pair (antichain_rangeWidens); in it every element begins and ends in every class, on precedence and on links (antichain_begins_ends).
laws.zh: 诸生皆以空过去（antichain、antichain_prec）：此历程含自空集起每一历程之茎（antichain_rangeIncludes），并扩大每一有一对者之茎（antichain_rangeWidens）；其中每元于每类皆生而即亡，读于先后与覆盖皆然（antichain_begins_ends）。

laws.en: Births above every element (chain, chain_prec_iff): each course from the empty set includes its stems (rangeIncludes_chain), each lacking a pair of it widens them (rangeWidens_chain), it continues most in each class read on precedence (continuation_le_chain). Each element is linked to the next (chain_link), each after the first abides on links once the next is born (chain_abides), the last ends (chain_last_ends).
laws.zh: 诸生皆在每元之上（chain 等）：自空集起之历程皆含其茎（rangeIncludes_chain），缺其一对者扩大之（rangeWidens_chain），读于先后，其于每类相续最多（continuation_le_chain）。每元与次元成覆盖（chain_link），首元后之每元于次元生后读于覆盖皆住（chain_abides），末元亡（chain_last_ends）。

laws.en: Two readings, reversed. Of two courses from the empty set, what continues in the one class (continuing) is included exactly where what can be born next is included the other way (rangeIncludes_continuing_iff); widening it is inclusion of precedence with a pair the other lacks (rangeWidens_continuing_iff), and narrows what can be born next (rangeWidens_stems_of_continuing).
laws.zh: 二读相反。自空集起之二历程，一类内之相续（continuing）之包含即次可生者之反向包含（rangeIncludes_continuing_iff）；扩大之即先后被含而有对方所无之对（rangeWidens_continuing_iff），并收窄次可生者（rangeWidens_stems_of_continuing）。

laws.en: Read on what continues, the chain widens every course from the empty set lacking one of its pairs (chain_rangeWidens_continuing). That narrowing what can be born next always widens what continues is again excluded middle (em_of_stems_converse, stems_converse_of_em, stems_converse_iff_em).
laws.zh: 读于相续，链扩大自空集起而缺其一对之每一历程（chain_rangeWidens_continuing）。收窄次可生者恒扩大相续，此亦即排中律（em_of_stems_converse、stems_converse_of_em、stems_converse_iff_em）。

laws.en: No strict order contains both widenings: one puts the antichain above the chain, the other the chain above the antichain (no_order_contains_both). An order never reversing widening what can be born next ranks no course from the empty set with a pair above the antichain (not_above_antichain), and the chain above no such course lacking one of its pairs (chain_not_above).
laws.zh: 无一严格之序兼含二种扩大：一者以反链高于链，另一者以链高于反链（no_order_contains_both）。不反转次可生者之扩大之序，不以自空集起而有一对之历程高于反链（not_above_antichain），亦不以链高于缺其一对之如是历程（chain_not_above）。

laws.en: Read on both together (formsOrContinues), of two courses from the empty set neither widens the other (not_rangeWidens_formsOrContinues), and two such courses one of which lacks a pair of the other are mixed: each exceeds the other (mixed_of_pair).
laws.zh: 兼读二者（formsOrContinues），自空集起之二历程无一扩大另一者（not_rangeWidens_formsOrContinues）；一者缺另一者之一对时，二者相杂：各超出对方（mixed_of_pair）。

laws.en: The courses' start. Most comparisons of two courses fail without the empty start. From a configuration, births with given pasts (Starts: grownFrom, with laws, fromEmptyPasts); from one element, every past empty (one, fromOne, with laws), a course widens the antichain's stems with the same, empty, precedence (fromOne_widens), so the strict and exceeding comparisons fail without the start (strict_needs_starts).
laws.zh: 历程之始。二历程之比较多需自空集起。自一构型依所给之过去而生（Starts：grownFrom 等、fromEmptyPasts）；自一元起、诸过去皆空（one、fromOne 等），一历程以相同之空先后扩大反链之茎（fromOne_widens），故无此始则严格与超出之比较不成立（strict_needs_starts）。

laws.en: Against the antichain, in which nothing continues (Starts.antichain_not_continuing), that course also refutes, without the start, not_widens_and_continues, rangeIncludes_continuing_iff and not_rangeWidens_formsOrContinues (Starts: the three laws named for them with _needs_starts, and fromOne_widens_formsOrContinues).
laws.zh: 对反链（其中无相续，antichain_not_continuing），无此始该历程亦否证 not_widens_and_continues 等三律（Starts：各以其名加 _needs_starts，及 fromOne_widens_formsOrContinues）。

laws.en: The course bearing 1 above 0 (Starts: onePast, oneAbove, with laws) lacks at offset 0 the pair (0, 1) of the course from the two-chain, every past empty (twoChain, fromTwo, fromTwo_prec_iff), yet exceeds it on neither reading (rangeWidens_of_needs_starts, mixed_of_pair_needs_starts); an order never reversing widening can rank the latter above the antichain (not_above_antichain_needs_start, with two stem laws).
laws.zh: 以 1 生于 0 上之历程（Starts：oneAbove 等）于偏移 0 缺自二元链起、诸过去皆空之历程（fromTwo 等）之对 (0, 1)，而于二读皆不超出之（rangeWidens_of_needs_starts、mixed_of_pair_needs_starts）；不反转扩大之序可以后者高于反链（not_above_antichain_needs_start）。

laws.en: The chain from one element (Starts: chainFromOnePast, chainFromOne, with laws) includes the chain's stems, continues at least as much in the one class and has a pair the chain lacks (prec_iff_of_both_needs_starts, continuation_of_rangeIncludes_needs_starts, rangeWidens_stems_of_continuing_needs_starts). Keeping widening needs a causal set at the start (full, full_stem_empty, keepsWidening_needs_start).
laws.zh: 自一元起之链（Starts：chainFromOne 等）含链之茎、一类内相续不少，且有链所无之对（prec_iff_of_both_needs_starts 等三律）。不断扩大需始于因果集（full、full_stem_empty、keepsWidening_needs_start）。

laws.en: No configuration renews without end. Where a relation raises the label and relates only below a bound, every element ceases under every class (ceases_of_bounded); so on every causal set of the growth every element ceases, on precedence and on links (ordered_ceases), and the grammar's «生生» holds on no configuration (ordered_not_renews).
laws.zh: 无构型 «生生»。凡一关系使标号升高且仅关联于一界之下，每元于每类皆息（ceases_of_bounded）；故于生长之每一因果集，每元皆息，读于先后与覆盖皆然（ordered_ceases），文法之 «生生» 于任何构型皆不成立（ordered_not_renews）。

laws.en: In the limits the extremes part. On the antichain's limit nothing renews without end in any class (antichainLimit, antichainLimit_not_renews). On the chain's limit, i before j exactly where i < j (chainLimit, chainLimit_iff), 1 renews without end under the class pairing 2m with 2m + 1 (chainLimit_renews; Halves: half, pairs, pairs_class, double_succ, half_double, half_double_succ, half_lt, odd).
laws.zh: 于极限，二极相分。反链之极限中，任何类下皆无 «生生» 者（antichainLimit、antichainLimit_not_renews）。链之极限中，i 先于 j 恰当 i < j（chainLimit、chainLimit_iff），于将 2m 与 2m + 1 相配之类下，1 «生生»（chainLimit_renews；Halves）。

laws.en: On links a finer class can gain or lose continuation by widening. The wider course bears 2 above 0, the narrower 1 above 0 and 2 above both, and the class sets 1 apart (Finer: widePast, narrowPast, classOf, wide, narrow, with laws). The wider widens the narrower (widens); the class continues from 0 to 2 on links in it (continues), not in the narrower (not_continues), nor in the antichain, which widens it (loses).
laws.zh: 读于覆盖，较细之类可因扩大而得或失相续。较宽之历程以 2 生于 0 上，较窄者以 1 生于 0 上、2 生于二者之上；类将 1 单列（Finer）。较宽者扩大较窄者（widens），类于其中沿覆盖自 0 续至 2（continues），于较窄者中则否（not_continues），于扩大较宽者之反链中亦否（loses）。

laws.en: Up to relabelling the pasts reverse the inclusion of precedence (Kinds: Relabels, Isomorphic, Included): where the first configuration's elements are carried one to one into the second's, a stem of the second, carried over, is one of the first exactly where the first's precedence, carried back, is included in the second's (stems_carried_iff); one size is not needed (stems_carried_unequal).
laws.zh: 重新编号下，过去仍反转先后之包含（Kinds：Relabels、Isomorphic、Included）：前一构型之元一一携入后者，则后者之每茎携过来为前者之茎，恰当前者之先后携回含于后者之先后（stems_carried_iff）；二者无须同大小（stems_carried_unequal）。

laws.en: The kinds of birth do not. At offset 2 the antichain's births above 0 and above 1 are of one kind, by exchanging 0 and 1 (Kinds: swap, swap_fixed, swap_swap, swap_below, antichain_two_stems_one_kind), and neither extreme's kinds of birth are among the other's (not_included_antichain_chain, not_included_chain_antichain), while at offset 0 each is among the other's (included_at_zero).
laws.zh: 生之种类则否。于偏移 2，反链生于 0 上与 1 上者为一种（Kinds：swap 等、antichain_two_stems_one_kind）；二极之种类皆不全在对方之中（not_included_antichain_chain、not_included_chain_antichain），而于偏移 0 则互在其中（included_at_zero）。

laws.en: The order on courses stays labelled. The course bearing 2 above 1 is Finer.wide with 0 and 1 exchanged (Kinds: swappedPast, swapped_two, swapped, swap_eq_two_iff, swap_eq_one_iff, wide_prec_iff_swapped); from offset 2 on the two grow configurations of one kind (wide_swapped_isomorphic), and each exceeds the other's stems (wide_swapped_mixed).
laws.zh: 历程之序仍依标号。以 2 生于 1 上之历程即 Finer.wide 交换 0 与 1 者（Kinds：swapped 等、wide_prec_iff_swapped）；自偏移 2 起二者所生之构型为一种（wide_swapped_isomorphic），而各超出对方之茎（wide_swapped_mixed）。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. Each law holds on every course of the growth, on every causal set, or on a witness; the comparisons take both courses from the empty set, and most fail without it (Starts); continuation_links_one_iff, continuation_links_one_of_rangeIncludes, pair_of_not_included and rangeExceeds_iff_pair take precedence decidable.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。每一律于生长之每一历程、每一因果集或一见证上成立；历程之比较需二者皆自空集起，否则多不成立（Starts）；continuation_links_one_iff 等四律需先后可判定。

hypotheses.en: Modelling choices: discrete steps; configurations finite and labelled, each element preceded only by smaller labels; precedence and pasts Prop-valued; courses compared at the same offsets and from the empty set, so the order on courses is labelled, pointwise, with no function extensionality; infinite causal sets read as courses and their limits; stems compared by inclusion, not counted.
hypotheses.zh: 建模之选：离散之步；构型有限且有标号，每元仅为较小标号者所先；先后与过去皆为命题值；历程自空集起、于同偏移处逐点相较，故历程之序依标号，不用函数外延性；无穷因果集读作历程及其极限；茎以包含相较，不计数。

does_not_show.en: That widening and continuation are opposed on every process: the reversal is shown on causal-set growth, labelled configurations compared at the same offsets from the empty set.
does_not_show.zh: 扩大与相续于每一过程上皆相反：此反转仅示于因果集之生长上，有标号之构型自空集起于同偏移处相较。

does_not_show.en: Anything about transition probabilities, Bell causality, discrete general covariance as a condition on a dynamics, or the continuum limit.
does_not_show.zh: 关于转移概率、贝尔因果性、作为动力学条件之离散广义协变或连续极限之任何事。

does_not_show.en: That continuation of a finer class read on links is ordered by widening: on witnesses it is gained and lost.
does_not_show.zh: 读于覆盖之较细之类之相续为扩大所序：于见证上其或得或失。

does_not_show.en: How kinds of birth are ordered beyond the witnesses at offset 2; a count to five elements is a computation, not a law.
does_not_show.zh: 生之种类于偏移 2 之见证之外如何排序；至五元之计数为计算，非律。

does_not_show.en: Which course is better: with every continuation's losses counted the reading is on both together, where C ranks no two courses from the empty set; ordering them needs a measure, beyond C and the condition. AI readings.
does_not_show.zh: 何历程更好：计每一相续之所失，则兼读二者，C 于此不排任何二自空集起之历程；排之需度量，在 C 与条件之外。皆 AI 之读。

does_not_show.en: The second-order direction: every course keeps widening what can be born next, so a range whose widening keeps widening is not told apart from one merely wider now.
does_not_show.zh: 二阶方向：每一历程皆使次可生者不断扩大，故其扩大不断扩大之范围与仅此刻较宽者于此不可分。

detail.en: The course of births with empty pasts includes every course's stems, and in it every element begins and ends in every class (antichain_rangeIncludes, antichain_begins_ends).
detail.zh: 诸生皆以空过去之历程含每一历程之茎，其中每元于每类皆生而即亡（antichain_rangeIncludes、antichain_begins_ends）。

detail.en: The antichain and the chain each widen the other on one of the two readings, so no strict order contains both (no_order_contains_both).
detail.zh: 反链与链各于二读之一上扩大对方，故无一严格之序兼含二者（no_order_contains_both）。

detail.en: Read on links, a class continues from 0 to 2 in one course and not in a course it widens, nor in the antichain, which widens it (Finer.continues, Finer.not_continues, Finer.loses).
detail.zh: 读于覆盖，类于一历程中自 0 续至 2，于其所扩大之历程中则否，于扩大之之反链中亦否（Finer.continues、Finer.not_continues、Finer.loses）。

detail.en: Two stems of the antichain whose births are of one kind, and at offset 2 neither extreme's kinds of birth among the other's (Kinds.antichain_two_stems_one_kind, Kinds.not_included_antichain_chain, Kinds.not_included_chain_antichain).
detail.zh: 反链之二茎，其生为一种；于偏移 2，二极之生之种类皆不全在对方之中（Kinds.antichain_two_stems_one_kind、Kinds.not_included_antichain_chain、Kinds.not_included_chain_antichain）。

detail.en: From one element, every past empty, a course widens the antichain's stems with the same, empty, precedence, so the strict comparison needs the empty start (Starts.fromOne_widens, Starts.strict_needs_starts).
detail.zh: 自一元起、诸过去皆空之历程，以相同之空先后扩大反链之茎，故严格之比较需自空集起（Starts.fromOne_widens、Starts.strict_needs_starts）。

detail.en: The course bearing 2 above 0 exactly where P: where P is not refuted the antichain exceeds its stems, and finding the pair decides P, so finding it for every two courses is excluded middle (Undecided.antichain_exceeds_onlyIf, pair_converse_iff_em).
detail.zh: 恰于 P 时以 2 生于 0 上之历程：凡 P 未被否证，反链超出其茎，而求得其对即判定 P，故对每二历程皆求得之即排中律（Undecided.antichain_exceeds_onlyIf、pair_converse_iff_em）。

detail.en: Two courses growing configurations of one kind at every offset from 2 on each exceed the other's stems (Kinds.wide_swapped_isomorphic, Kinds.wide_swapped_mixed).
detail.zh: 自偏移 2 起所生之构型为一种之二历程，各超出对方之茎（Kinds.wide_swapped_isomorphic、Kinds.wide_swapped_mixed）。

Many laws restate known order theory.

next_delta.en: Covariance on the growth: births of unrelated elements commuting up to relabelling, presence at a birth not invariant, an order on courses up to relabelling, and the kinds of birth counted with the stems decided; review by a person.
next_delta.zh: 生长上之协变：无关之元之生于重编号下可交换，于某生时之在场非不变量，重编号下历程之序，以及茎可判定时生之种类之计数；人之审查。

correspondence.en: Rideout and Sorkin's classical sequential growth (2000) read as a process: internal temporality as holding the past, their timid and gregarious children as the chain's and the antichain's births. That stems reverse the inclusion of precedence is the order-reversing correspondence between orders on one set and their down-sets, the specialization order of an Alexandrov topology; Birkhoff's representation of finite distributive lattices is a neighbour. Kauffman's adjacent possible (2000), as two reviews report his tentative fourth law, read for a prestated space as what can be born next, on the pasts and on kinds of birth. Discrete general covariance read only as relabelling. The calibrations, excluded middle for finding the pair a widening loses and for narrowing always widening what continues, are lemmas: which pair a widening loses is found by deciding. Graded in UE13's NOTE.
correspondence.zh: Rideout 与 Sorkin 之经典序贯生长（2000）读作过程：内在时间性即持守过去，其怯子与群子为链与反链之生。茎反转先后之包含，即一集上之序与其下集间之保逆对应，亦即 Alexandrov 拓扑之特化序；有限分配格之 Birkhoff 表示为其近邻。Kauffman 之相邻可能（2000，据二书评所述其试探之第四律）读于可预先列出之空间上，为次可生者，读于过去及生之种类。离散广义协变仅读作重编号。校准（求扩大所失之对、收窄恒扩大相续，皆即排中律）为引理：扩大所失之对须判定而得。分级见 UE13 之 NOTE。

aliases: What can be born next against what continues

detail.en: Causet and Causet.Ordered, the links and links_of_iff, the reach of links where precedence is decidable (in continuation_links_one_iff), and Undecided.third with its calibration (in reach_links_courses_iff_em).
detail.zh: Causet 与 Causet.Ordered、覆盖与 links_of_iff、先后可判定时覆盖之及（于 continuation_links_one_iff），以及 Undecided.third 及其校准（于 reach_links_courses_iff_em）。

detail.en: Run.RangeIncludes, Run.RangeExceeds, Run.RangeWidens, Reaching.KeepsWidening and Run.possible_from_start: what a course admits compared at the same offsets, keeping widening, and the possible from a course's start.
detail.zh: Run.RangeIncludes、Run.RangeExceeds、Run.RangeWidens、Reaching.KeepsWidening 与 Run.possible_from_start：历程于同偏移处所纳之比较、不断扩大与自历程之始之可能。

detail.en: Reaching.heldMoves, Reaching.PossibleHeld and Reaching.PossibleHeld.possible: the possible with the past held.
detail.zh: Reaching.heldMoves、Reaching.PossibleHeld 与 Reaching.PossibleHeld.possible：持守过去时之可能。

detail.en: «及», «续», «相续», «一», «类», «则», «生», «亡», «住», «息», «生生», «生生之展», «生生不息» and «及之单调»: continuation, its positions, ceasing and renewal without end.
detail.zh: «及»、«续»、«相续»、«一»、«类»、«则»、«生»、«亡»、«住»、«息»、«生生»、«生生之展»、«生生不息» 与 «及之单调»：续及其诸位、息与 «生生»。

detail.en: Its same-offset comparison read on causal-set growth, where including what can be born next is having precedence included, and keeping widening holds on every course from a causal set.
detail.zh: 其同偏移之比较读于因果集之生长上：含次可生者即先后被含，自因果集起之每一历程皆不断扩大。

detail.en: Internal temporality read as holding the past, so the held possible is the whole possible on causal-set growth.
detail.zh: 内在时间性读作持守过去，故于因果集之生长上持守之可能即全部可能。

detail.en: The present on causal-set growth: the natural labellings of a causal set are exactly the orders of birth of the courses from the empty set growing a configuration of its kind.
detail.zh: 因果集生长上之现在：一因果集之自然编号，恰为自空集起生同种构型之诸历程之生序。

history.en: 28 October 2026: added (UE13), what can be born next against what continues: sequential growth a process holding the past, on whose every course from a causal set what can be born next keeps widening; the stems reverse the inclusion of precedence, labelled or up to relabelling, so widening adds no continuation; read on what continues the order reverses and no strict order contains both; finding the pair a widening loses is excluded middle; most comparisons need the empty start; no configuration renews without end; a finer class on links; kinds of birth not so ordered; after a review and a re-check; study section 431.
history.zh: 2026年10月28日：新增（UE13），次可生者与相续：序贯生长为持守过去之过程，自因果集起之每一历程上次可生者不断扩大；茎反转先后之包含（有标号或重编号下皆然），故扩大不增相续；读于相续则序反转，无一严格之序兼含二者；求扩大所失之对即排中律；多数比较需自空集起；无构型生生不息；读于覆盖之较细之类；生之种类不如是排序；经审查与复查；研究第 431 节。

history.en: 3 November 2026, CD (board item CD): the statement says that read on what continues the inclusion reverses, not the order; law 16 and a counterexample say that the two widenings put the antichain and the chain above each other, not that they rank them; what the record does not show names the start C's verdict on both readings together needs, from the empty set (Starts.not_rangeWidens_formsOrContinues_needs_starts). Under the glossary's one sense, ranking and order (the ethics' role word) say which course is better, and widening says which admits more, with no premise. The claim is unchanged.
